properties.description: Home of the Seattle Mariners — a waterfront MLB stadium with a retractable roof, skyline views and diverse stadium food and event offerings.
properties.short_description: Home of the Seattle Mariners — a waterfront MLB stadium with a retractable roof, skyline views and diverse stadium food and event offerings.
properties.overall_description: T-Mobile Park is a premier, multipurpose stadium in downtown Seattle, widely recognized as the home of the Seattle Mariners. Featuring a versatile retractable roof, the venue provides a comfortable environment for baseball games, major concerts, and community celebrations regardless of the weather. Known for its modern facilities, diverse food options, and proximity to the city skyline, the park delivers an electric atmosphere that appeals to families, sports enthusiasts, and event-goers. Its central location, combined with accessible public transit, makes it an essential destination for experiencing the vibrant culture and entertainment scene of Seattle.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is energetic and social, characterized by a lively sports-centric vibe that feels welcoming to families and large crowds alike. Modern amenities and efficient management help maintain a clean, organized, and festive environment during events.
properties.amenities_description: The facility is equipped with a state-of-the-art retractable roof, an expansive video scoreboard, and numerous food and beverage concessions catering to diverse tastes. It offers dedicated family areas, efficient transit links, and professional staff support to ensure a seamless guest experience.
properties.unique_selling_points: The stadium is distinguished by its iconic retractable roof and stunning views of the Seattle skyline, offering a year-round venue for both Major League Baseball and premier entertainment. Its unique bullpen design and high-quality local food offerings create a memorable, distinctly Pacific Northwest experience.
properties.neighborhood_description: The surrounding neighborhood is a bustling, central district that serves as a vibrant sports and entertainment hub. It is highly walkable and well-connected by public transportation, making it a convenient destination for visitors.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in the heart of Seattle, this waterfront stadium features a retractable roof and provides sweeping views of the city skyline. Its urban position offers convenient access to local transit and serves as a multipurpose venue for sports and large-scale public events.

properties.description: 68,740-seat waterfront multipurpose stadium in Seattle hosting NFL, MLS, concerts, and international events with downtown skyline views.
properties.short_description: 68,740-seat waterfront multipurpose stadium in Seattle hosting NFL, MLS, concerts, and international events with downtown skyline views.
properties.overall_description: Lumen Field is a world-class, 68,740-seat multipurpose stadium located in the heart of Seattle, serving as the iconic home of the Seahawks, Sounders FC, and Seattle Reign. Recognized for its sustainability efforts and impressive acoustics, the venue hosts major concerts, international soccer matches, and trade shows. With its modern design, excellent city views, and passionate local fan base, it stands as a premier destination for sports and entertainment fans from around the globe.
properties.ambience_description: The stadium offers an electric, high-energy atmosphere during events, paired with clean, modern facilities and a welcoming, professional service standard.
properties.amenities_description: The venue features extensive concessions with a wide variety of food and drinks, clean restroom facilities, and accessible seating. It is well-equipped for guests with needs via elevators and a dedicated sensory room for calming.
properties.unique_selling_points: Known for its iconic architecture and electric atmosphere, the stadium offers excellent sightlines from almost every seat and hosts top-tier international sporting events and major world-tour concerts.
properties.neighborhood_description: The surrounding neighborhood is a bustling, highly accessible area of Seattle packed with restaurants, hotels, and businesses that come alive during major stadium events.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in the heart of Seattle, this sprawling, open-air waterfront stadium is a central hub for major sporting and entertainment events. It offers striking views of the downtown city skyline.

properties.short_description: Sustainability-focused downtown Seattle arena hosting hockey, basketball, concerts, and events with a living-plant interior and up to 17,000 capacity.
properties.overall_description: Climate Pledge Arena is a world-class, sustainability-focused entertainment venue located in the heart of downtown Seattle. Housed within the historic shell of the former Key Arena, it offers a modern, high-energy environment for major sporting events like NHL hockey and large-scale concerts. The facility is praised for its exceptional acoustics, clear sightlines from every seat, and innovative amenities including walk-out checkout technology and sensory accommodations. While it is a premier destination for entertainment, visitors should plan for busy traffic and premium pricing for food and parking.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is energetic and modern, characterized by a sophisticated, eco-conscious aesthetic and a state-of-the-art facility design. It offers a professional, organized environment suited for large-scale public entertainment.
properties.amenities_description: The arena features modern amenities including diverse food and beverage options with automated self-checkout technology, various VIP club spaces, and accessible infrastructure like elevators and sensory-friendly accommodations.
properties.unique_selling_points: As the world's most sustainable arena, the venue impressively integrates a living-plant wall and cutting-edge eco-friendly technology within a historic structural shell. It provides exceptional acoustics and sightlines, ensuring a world-class viewing experience from every seat.
properties.neighborhood_description: The arena is situated in a busy, central district of Seattle that is dense with activity and highly walkable. The surrounding area is lively and well-connected, making it a primary hub for city entertainment and events.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in downtown Seattle, this state-of-the-art facility is built within the historic shell of the former Key Arena. The interior features a striking, modern design with a prominent living-plant wall, while the exterior is set in a vibrant urban environment.

properties.description: Large lakeside football stadium with sweeping views of Lake Washington and the Cascade Mountains.
properties.short_description: Large lakeside football stadium with sweeping views of Lake Washington and the Cascade Mountains.
properties.overall_description: Husky Stadium is a premier college football venue located on the University of Washington campus, celebrated for its status as the most scenic setting in American collegiate sports. The stadium offers an electrifying atmosphere, characterized by passionate fan traditions, unique lakeside tailgating, and stunning vistas of Lake Washington and the Cascade Mountains. Following extensive renovations, it provides modern facilities and premium seating options while maintaining its historic charm. It remains a must-visit destination for sports enthusiasts looking for a memorable and immersive game-day experience.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is intensely energetic and spirited, especially on game days when the venue fills with cheering fans and a sense of collective excitement. It provides a classic, high-energy environment defined by long-standing traditions and a passionate local community.
properties.amenities_description: The facility features a variety of fan amenities, including diverse food and beverage concessions, team gear shops, and premium hospitality suites. Modern conveniences like cashless payment systems and express entry lanes help manage large crowds efficiently.
properties.unique_selling_points: Widely considered the most beautiful setting in college football, the stadium is famous for its unique 'sailgating' tradition where fans gather on boats in Lake Washington. Its combination of grand mountain vistas and proximity to the water creates an unmatched viewing experience.
properties.neighborhood_description: The stadium is located on the University of Washington campus, creating a vibrant, collegiate atmosphere that is highly accessible via public transit. It serves as a central hub for university life and major regional events.
properties.physical_setting_description: Situated directly on the shores of the Montlake Cut at Lake Washington, the stadium offers dramatic panoramic views of the water, the Olympic Mountains, and the Cascade range. This scenic location is widely regarded as one of the most beautiful settings in college sports.

properties.short_description: 10,000-seat University of Washington arena on the Montlake campus, hosting basketball, gymnastics, and volleyball with a historic pavilion atmosphere.
properties.overall_description: Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion is a historic, intimate venue located on the University of Washington campus. Known for its lively atmosphere, the arena hosts a variety of university events including basketball, volleyball, gymnastics, and graduation ceremonies. Despite its age, the facility is highly regarded for its excellent sightlines, where no seat is considered bad, and its passionate collegiate environment.
properties.ambience_description: The arena provides an energetic and intimate atmosphere, characterized by its historic charm and a passionate collegiate spirit that makes it feel loud and exciting during games.
properties.amenities_description: The facility includes standard sports arena amenities such as multiple concession stands, a team merchandise store, and the Husky Hall of Fame, with cashless payment options in use.
properties.unique_selling_points: The arena is renowned for its historic character and intimate layout, which ensures that every seat in the house provides a clear view of the court.
properties.neighborhood_description: The arena is situated within the bustling, scenic surroundings of a major university campus, offering convenient access to public transportation such as the light rail.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located on the University of Washington's Montlake campus, this historic indoor arena offers an intimate, pavilion-style setting for sporting events and ceremonies. Its design ensures clear sightlines from virtually any seat in the house.

properties.description: Historic sports stadium with 1930s-era stands, a rubberized track and football field, hosting local high-school games, track meets, and community rentals.
properties.short_description: Historic sports stadium with 1930s-era stands, a rubberized track and football field, hosting local high-school games, track meets, and community rentals.
properties.overall_description: West Seattle Stadium is a historic community landmark originally built in 1938 as part of a Works Progress Administration project. It remains a popular local destination for runners and athletes, featuring a high-quality, recently resurfaced track and the city's last remaining wooden grandstand. While the facilities retain a charming, old-school aesthetic, they provide a peaceful and functional environment for daily exercise and community sports.
properties.ambience_description: The stadium maintains a nostalgic, old-school atmosphere that feels quiet and peaceful for daily exercise. Its historic wooden grandstands provide a unique, classic character.
properties.amenities_description: The facility includes an eight-lane rubberized track, a grass football field, and both covered and uncovered seating areas. On-site restrooms are available for public use.
properties.unique_selling_points: It features the city's only remaining wooden grandstand, originally constructed in 1938 by the Works Progress Administration. The track is highly regarded for its quality and accessibility for local training.
properties.neighborhood_description: Located in a quiet and convenient residential area, the stadium offers a peaceful retreat that feels tucked away from the surrounding urban bustle.
properties.physical_setting_description: A historic, 1930s-era sports stadium featuring a well-maintained rubberized track and football field. The facility is set against a backdrop offering scenic mountain views on clear days.

properties.description: Counter-serve late-night spot known for mozzarella-stuffed fat sandwiches, indulgent burgers, wings, and deep-fried desserts.
properties.short_description: Counter-serve late-night spot known for mozzarella-stuffed fat sandwiches, indulgent burgers, wings, and deep-fried desserts.
properties.cuisine_description: Fat Shack specializes in American comfort food, featuring iconic fat sandwiches jam-packed with various toppings, 100% Angus beef burgers, chicken wings, and deep-fried desserts like Oreos and cheesecake bites. The menu also includes Philly cheesesteaks and loaded cheese fries. The establishment provides some vegetarian options and maintains a full bar.
properties.overall_description: This spot is a quintessential late-night destination known for its indulgent menu featuring oversized sandwiches stuffed with fried sides, burgers, and deep-fried desserts. Located below street level in a bustling urban area, it serves as a reliable fueling station for post-game crowds, pub-goers, and anyone seeking high-calorie comfort food after hours. While the service style is casual and counter-serve, the menu is built for those looking to satisfy major cravings with iconic combinations of grease, cheese, and carbs.
properties.service_description: Fat Shack offers a variety of service options including dine-in, takeout, and delivery via online platforms. The restaurant is particularly popular as a late-night dining destination, suitable for individuals looking for quick, indulgent bites after sporting events, concerts, or nights out at local pubs.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is casual and unpretentious, frequently filled with a post-event or late-night crowd looking for hearty sustenance in a laid-back setting.
properties.amenities_description: The establishment provides dine-in seating, a bar, and offers multiple service channels including counter service, takeout, and delivery.
properties.unique_selling_points: Famous for signature 'fat' sandwiches that are stuffed with multiple fried toppings like mozzarella sticks and chicken fingers, alongside deep-fried desserts.
properties.neighborhood_description: The neighborhood is a central, high-traffic urban area known for being a hub for sports stadiums, nightlife, and concert venues.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in a bustling city center, the restaurant is situated below street level, accessed via stairs with a subterranean vibe.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The typical customer base consists of young adults, locals, and event attendees looking for late-night sustenance. The crowd includes groups of friends and individuals seeking casual, indulgent comfort food after evening outings.
